attributes.description: Deferred note 2880 (read it in full). arm_types.py keeps azurerm_container_app_job in the side Terraform root ('no ARM form is written for the check jobs yet'), and with it the per-job publisher and pull grants scoped to inputs. Write a Native for azurerm_container_app_job in the image-delivery form only (Microsoft.App/jobs: identity, configuration.registries [server, identity], scheduleTriggerConfig, secrets with keyVaultUrl + identity, template.containers with env); script delivery stays KEPT for its file(). API version: newest stable in the Bicep type index the repo uses (check how arm_types picks others; no web research: escalate if you can't tell). The grants that only stayed in Terraform because of the job move with it where the table allows. Read back: the job round-trips through the ARM read-back (rendered_deployments + the azure/arm reader) as the Terraform read-back does (test_arm_coverage / native parity). Rules: brief 2991 + U.14 rules 3002 (line-length test, AIMFP loop, deletion manifests). Golden: none expected (golden holds no Bicep renders); the Azure sample (examples/showcase/tests/terraform/azure_sample.py) must still build: list the bicep marker tests for the master. Boundary: packages/opsdir-adapter-azure arm_types.py, arm_render.py, check_jobs.py, rendered_state.py, arm.py, their tests and README; NOT inventory.py, landing.py, collect.py, plumbing.py (worker-1's task 513): escalate if the read-back needs them.
